items.item: The normal planner's near-exhaustive search, first introduced in System R, can take enormous time and memory for large joins
geqo_threshold defaults to 12 FROM items; GEQO trades a guarantee of the best plan for a bound on planning time
GEQO's mechanics: join orders as integer strings, a steady-state genetic algorithm, edge recombination crossover, fitness = lower estimated cost
GEQO's own documented doubt about fitting query optimization to a TSP-shaped genetic algorithm
